not_authorized_body: This area is for platform administrators. If you reached it by typing the URL, your account does not have admin access — and the API would refuse the request anyway.
access_unknown_body: Your account details didn't load, so this page stays hidden until they do.
crash_body: The panel ran into a problem rendering this page. Reloading usually fixes it; if it keeps happening, send the error details below to your admin.
crash_updated_body: A new version of the panel was just released. Reload to open this page.
not_found_body: The name in the link is not valid, or the page does not exist.
connection_lost: Can't reach Felis: the network is down, or your Cloudflare Access sign-in expired. This clears by itself once the network is back; an expired Access sign-in needs a page reload.
config_unavailable: The panel configuration (/config.json) did not load, so server addresses and links shown here may be wrong. Reload to try again.
address_copy_failed: Selected — copy it from the menu
refresh_failed: Couldn't refresh; what you see is the last status read.
